notes: אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים → the man of God: rectum anarthrous, the article's the fronted (rule 29).
לְהַכּוֹת → Thou shouldest have smitten: no word written for the לְ, so it is unrepresented; subject and modal join the infinitive (rules 40, 52).
וְעַתָּה → whereas now: adverb takes now, waw takes the connective left over (rule 14). Restrictive but is added.
